Bill.BriefDescription: Identifying the employers of persons receiving certain state-funded health benefits.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health care services; adding a new section tochapter 41.05 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For purposes of this section only, "small employer" means anyperson, firm, corporation, partnership, association, politicalsubdivision, or selfemployed individual that is actively engaged inbusiness that, during the preceding calendar quarter, employed no morethan fifty employees who worked an average of thirty or more hours perweek. For purposes of this section only, "large employer" means anyperson, firm, corporation, partnership, association, politicalsubdivision, or selfemployed individual that is actively engaged inbusiness that, during the preceding calendar quarter, employed morethan fifty employees who worked an average of thirty or more hours perweek. The administrator shall identify the employers of any personreceiving benefits through the basic health plan for themselves or p. 1 SHB 3047their dependents. On or before February 1st of each year, theadministrator shall provide the appropriate committees of the senateand house of representatives a report of employers whose employees arereceiving benefits through the basic health plan for themselves ortheir dependents. The report must include whether the employer is alarge employer or a small employer, and for each employer: (1) Thename and address of the employer; (2) the number of employees who arereceiving benefits through the basic health plan; (3) the number ofenrollees who are spouses or dependents of their employees; (4) whetherthe employer offers health benefits to their employees; and (5) thecost to the state of providing basic health plan benefits for theiremployees and enrolled dependents.
